name: TP Product Description in Loop for WooCommerce
author: TPlugins

sections.description:
TP Product Description in Loop for WooCommerce is a plugin designed for WooCommerce that adds product descriptions to your Shop, Category, and Archive pages. It allows you to display the short or full product description, custom descriptions, CSS customization, and more.

Learn more about TP Product Description in Loop for WooCommerce Plugin features:
Learn more: https://www.tplugins.com/product/tp-product-description-in-loop-for-woocommerce/

Demo:
Click here for the demo: https://www.tplugins.com/demos/ex2/product-category/tp-product-description-in-loop/?reff=TPPDIL

Pro Version:
Click here to get the Pro version: https://www.tplugins.com/product/tp-product-description-in-loop-for-woocommerce/

Free Plugin Features

  • Fully responsive layout, adapting to any device.
  • Option to enable/disable on mobile devices.
  • Option to enable/disable on all product pages.
  • Display full or short product description.
  • Customize colors, background, font sizes, and more.
  • Select description position within the product loop.
  • RTL (Right to Left) language support.
  • SEO-friendly.
  • Compatible with most premium WordPress themes.

Pro Plugin Features

  • Fully responsive layout for any device.
  • Option to enable/disable on mobile devices.
  • Option to enable/disable on Shop page, Related Products, and Up-Sells.
  • Display full or short product description.
  • Custom description: override the default product description.
  • Limit description length.
  • Show more content in a sleek tooltip.
  • Customize tooltip’s color, background, font size, and more.
  • Exclude description from specific categories.
  • Exclude description from specific tags.
  • Disable description for specific products.
  • Select description position within the product loop.
  • Custom CSS.
  • RTL (Right to Left) language support.
  • SEO-friendly.
  • Compatible with most premium WordPress themes.

  • ✅ TP Product Tooltip for WooCommerce: https://wordpress.org/plugins/tp-product-tooltip/
sections.installation:
1. Extract the downloaded ZIP file.
  2. Upload the plugin folder to the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress site.
  3. Activate “TP Product Description in Loop for WooCommerce” via the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

After activation, a new menu item called “TP Product Description in Loop” will appear in your WordPress menu. Here, you can configure all the plugin settings.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce installed on my site?

Yes, this plugin is designed to work with WooCommerce, so you’ll need a WooCommerce store on your site.

What about mobile devices?

TP Product Description in Loop is fully responsive and tested on all devices and screen resolutions.

I need a feature that you don’t have. What should I do?

No problem! Contact us via our Contact Page and let us know what you need. Our team will be happy to assist you.

Can I customize the plugin?

Yes, you can. Go to the plugin settings to change colors, backgrounds, icons, and more.

Can I use this plugin with Elementor?

Yes, this plugin works perfectly with Elementor.
